# BCGov Crow - v0.11.1

## Release type

Patch release

## Summary

Crow adds an opt-in daily update reminder during Copilot agent use and a
release-maintained APM update track, without scheduled tasks or automatic
upgrades.

## Highlights

- The Raven Setup Agent offers an optional user-level Copilot hook once.
  After consent, it checks Crow's stable release and any bundled Raven or
  codebase-memory-mcp release recorded by Crow Setup during prompt activity at
  most once every 24 hours. An unavailable release source does not suppress
  updates found elsewhere; failed checks retry after about one hour. Updates
  are never installed automatically.
- A release-maintained `stable` branch lets global APM installs follow
  published stable Crow releases. It is seeded after successful main-branch
  asset validation and advances only after a stable release is published.
  Exact-tag installations remain fixed until migrated.

## Changes

- Raven freshness checks now record their 24-hour timestamp only after APM
  checks succeed, so a failed check remains eligible for retry.
- Setup guidance explains exact-tag APM behavior and how to migrate to
  `#stable`. Install documentation retains version-pinned options, and both
  collections now declare the 0.11.1 package version and dependency refs.

## Validation

- Crow asset validation: Passed — 0 errors, 0 warnings.
- Package dry run: Passed — 196 files.
- Archive inspection: Passed — 196 entries; no evidence or local-state paths.
- Additional checks: Raven setup tests passed (40/40); Crow release guard tests
  passed; stable-branch workflow YAML parsing and PSScriptAnalyzer passed. The
  prior branch Sonar scan found no new issues, but its quality gate did not
  pass because coverage was 0.0% against a 10% threshold; exact release-commit
  Sonar validation remains outstanding.

## Installation

Install the tagged release globally:

```powershell
apm install bcgov/crow#v0.11.1 --global --target copilot
```

Or install the packaged archive:

```powershell
apm install .\build\bcgov-crow-0.11.1.zip --global --target copilot
```
